data.about:
Why should you connect with me?

Because I will work with you to shape visionary solutions, drive architectural excellence and deliver high quality results. My passion lies in designing scalable systems, mentoring teams, and aligning technology roadmaps with business objectives. Let us collaborate to build robust, future-proof software ecosystems that empower organizations to thrive!

My over 15 years of practical experience in the technology field has the following focuses:

Leadership & Communication:
• Demonstrated excellence in leading cross-functional, multicultural teams to deliver cutting-edge software solutions.
• Expertise in strategic communication, ensuring seamless collaboration among stakeholders to drive organizational goals.
• Adept in public speaking and presentations, with a strong ability to articulate technical concepts to varied audiences.
• Skilled in crafting comprehensive technical documentation, including policies, procedures, and reports, ensuring clarity and compliance.

Systems Design & Architecture:
• Experienced in strategic architectural solutions, delivering robust and scalable systems within best practices for short-term and long-term success.
• Proficient in design and architectural patterns, evaluating and implementing the optimal patterns for the goals and budget of each project within the targeted technology stack.
• Skilled in designing high-availability systems, with keen focus on testability, observability, and maintainability ensuring a high quality projects.
• Champion of Agile methodologies, facilitating rapid prototyping and iterative development to meet evolving business needs.
• Advocate for DevOps culture, integrating development and operations for streamlined deployment and continuous integration & delivery (CI/CD) processes.
• Expert in system analysis, facilitating visualized software design and architecture that enhances team understanding and project documentation.

Software Development Expertise:
• Versatile in programming languages including Java, C#, C++, Python, JavaScript, and PHP, with a focus on the SOLID principles.
• Strong foundation in style and markup languages such as HTML, XML, YAML, JSON and CSS, ensuring robust and responsive designs.
• Comprehensive understanding of database management, with experience in Access, DB2, Derby, MySQL, and Oracle.
• Proficient in leveraging frameworks like CakePHP, jQuery, and JavaEE to build scalable and efficient applications.
• Experienced with CMS platforms including Drupal, Joomla, and WordPress, enabling dynamic content management and user engagement.

description.text: Contributing to human welfare through biomedical engineering.

• Researching, designing, developing and implementing new features required for IBM WebSphere Application Server and IBM Liberty to comply with JavaEE7 specifications.

• Developing, implementing, enhancing and executing test automation suites to identify and document any defects and assist in preventing software regression.
• Debugging and fixing defects reported by test automation suites or the quality assurance teams. 
• Supporting the cross functional areas as well as being the liaison between the WebSphere and DB2 organizations as the owner of DB2 on WebSphere product family.
• Automating maintenance of build and test infrastructure machines with DB2 on Windows, Linux and AIX resulting in 70% less down time on enhanced machines.
• Leading the invention campaign as the Rochester focal point to increase the patenting activities in WebSphere organization.
• Leading IBM’s Bluemix activities in code camps in Minnesota, Pennsylvania, and Chicago.
• Initiating and leading IBM’s Bluemix first code camp in Kuwait and the MENA and successfully generating $20,000 support from sponsors.
• Designing and developing the car emulation system of the On-Board Diagnostic (OBD-II) model as a part of the Smarter Car API on IBM’s Bluemix.
• Mentoring and training interns working on JavaEE Connector Architecture (JCA) and Java Database Connectivity (JDBC) specification implementation.
• Supporting and contributing as a core member to IBM's Engineering Week responsible for bringing engineering to life for kids, educators, and parents and increasing public dialogue about the need for engineers.

• Analyzing clients' needs and mapping it into technical requirements
• Providing studied estimations on coding effort, time and budget to the project manager
• Coding, troubleshooting and utilizing desktop and web-enabled applications with the appropriate hardware, database, and programming technology
• Designing graphical interfaces to provide the best user experience possible within the selected interaction environments
• Analyzing performance of the software applications and taking actions to correct deficiencies based on the consultation with the client and the testing team
• Providing technical and functional support to the testing team
• Assisting the technical writing team in preparing the projects documentations
• Guiding and supervising the developing team in Jordan
• Implementing and integrating Content Management Systems (Joomla, Drupal and WordPress)

description.text: Customizing the web based application's forms by making it bilingual, applying more validation policies on the user input and providing more interactive help tools to suit the needs of both Silki and Lasilki as the main ISP companies in Iraq. Technologies used: HTML, XML, CSS, JavaScript, JSP and MySQL

Developing a desktop application that assists architects in their calculations for the required materials and the financial costs based on the building areas and shapes. The application allows a case by case and a full report generation. Technologies used: Java SE

Building a desktop application that converts the output from the previous version of Back Office System Server (BOSS – by PIPS Technology) to the new version BOSS 3.0. BOSS Convertor offers 3 work mechanisms (line converter, paragraph convertor, and file convertor) and 3 styles of operations (Manual based, Schedule based, and Event Driven Based). The second version of BOSS Convertor was reengineered to cut the time consumed for the data processing. In the testing environment it managed to minimize the 40 minutes required to process 3 million records to less than 9 minutes. BOSS Convertor now is successfully implemented within the used systems in the Data Centers of the Kuwaiti and Bahraini Ministry of Interior. Technologies used: Java SE and MySQL

Developing a multi-user web based phonebook application. The application enable users to store all their contacts' phone numbers and details of addresses online, share contacts with specified users or with all users, and write notes on the latest interactions and follow-ups done with the contact. Technologies used: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, XML, PHP, MySQL, Photoshop and Dreamweaver
